A precedent note is a description of something that already happened in public. It is not a score, and it does not pass a hard gate.

### Subject

Project or treasury, with a public URL.

### What is already public

Link the sources. Do not fill gaps with estimates. If a number is not in a source, leave it out.

### Where it would sit

`docs/precedents/` or `use-cases/`. Say which, and whether a page for this subject already exists.

### What this note must not claim

Say plainly if the subject has not agreed to be an example.
